caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sofa with ornate details and red upholstery. The sofa has a long seat and a gently curved backrest and arms, all upholstered in a textured red fabric. The wooden frame is medium brown with decorative carved patterns along the arms and legs, which end in claw-shaped feet. The sofa is set against a plain, off-white background, and is framed by a thin, rectangular border. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a small, rectangular inset containing a simple line sketch of the same sofa, annotated with dimensions: “7'2"” (width) and “3'6"” (height). At the bottom right corner of the main drawing, there are handwritten notes, including names and the date “1840.”
title: Sofa
